task_10_mechanism_rules.reading_caveat: the per-checkpoint mechanism label is defined on the KS statistic and on the standardized mean separation |mean delta| / pooled_sd; the standardized ratio is scale-sensitive, so a checkpoint with a much wider score spread can receive WEAK_SEPARATION while having a LARGER absolute mean separation. The scale-invariant ROC-AUC column is the primary separation measure and the mechanism column must be read alongside it, not instead of it.

cross_checkpoint_attribution.DISTRIBUTION_CROSSING: shift_answerable and shift_unanswerable have opposite signs and neither dominates by 2x

task_11_answers.A_why_null_score_reverses: the recorded null_score is the exact sum of the two [CLS] components (max identity error 1.0e-06 at F2 and 1.0e-06 at A0); delta_null flips sign (-0.0787 -> +0.5615) because both delta_start (-0.0531 -> +0.2861) and delta_end (-0.0256 -> +0.2754) flip sign between checkpoints (classification: BOTH_COMPONENTS)
task_11_answers.B_which_component_drives: both components flip: delta_start -0.0531 -> +0.2861 and delta_end -0.0256 -> +0.2754; neither component alone explains the sign change
task_11_answers.C_is_signal_in_answer_span: yes at F2: answer-span family AUC 0.7338 vs null family 0.4391 (gap +0.2947), and the recorded F2 margin~best_answer_score Spearman of -0.9206 shows margin carries almost the same ordering as the answer-span score; at A0 the same gap is +0.0175
task_11_answers.D_what_the_checkpoint_difference_is: ranking/order, not scale: ROC-AUC is invariant to any monotone rescaling, so the AUC differences cannot be produced by additive or multiplicative score scaling; the measured Spearman similarities and the paired delta-AUC CIs localise the difference to the ordering of examples

definitions.REVERSAL_EXPLAINED: component-level evidence explains the sign change clearly
definitions.REVERSAL_PARTIALLY_EXPLAINED: distribution/component evidence explains part of it but not all
definitions.REVERSAL_NOT_EXPLAINED: distributions do not identify a defensible mechanism

rationale: literal sign flip present for the null family: True
statistically established sign flip (at least one CI excludes 0.50 in its own direction): False
paired delta-AUC CI excludes 0 for any null-family statistic: False

the sign change itself is arithmetically fully accounted for (delta_null = delta_start + delta_end holds to 1e-6 and both components flip sign), but the AUC magnitudes remain chance-compatible in both checkpoints, so the reversal is not established as a reliable property
task_12_verdict.literal_reading: under a purely component-arithmetic reading the sign change is fully accounted for, which would satisfy REVERSAL_EXPLAINED; the applied verdict is the lower tier because the reversal is not statistically established

interpretation_boundary: No model loading, no inference, no GPU, no training, no database, no retrieval was used.
No threshold was fitted, no K searched, no classifier fitted, no combined score created.
Only recorded score fields were read; the frozen prediction artifact was not modified.
AUC is monotone-scale invariant, so no threshold-free AUC difference is attributed to score scaling.
These are score-distribution measurements of the CURRENT recorded outputs; they are not causal claims and not architecture evidence.
The category-stratified question is not answerable from this benchmark: every structural category contains answerable examples only.
